modelRequired: Initial relation, every real source action/stutter, concrete observation reflection and progress; claim/initialize/publish/acquire/scan/rescan/finish; source Tail and partial-copy states require extra relation

Publish qualified native participation and frozen context roots before acceptance; no-escape raw-enter through ready publication: cancellation/handler policy established before acceptance; no Scheme checkpoint, callback, logging, foreign unwind or local-only result ownership; OS preemption remains allowed

Before restoring masks/cancellation or propagating Scheme errors: release gate, publish outcome, retain result/root in stable service and restore VM/processor binding; stopped owner recovery needs independent scan/stop evidence

Point-specific live roots include exported GVM registers, saved values, type caches, frame/denv roots, host locals and all RC domains; address/location coverage, lifetime and writable relocation slots required; no arbitrary C-stack inference

Acquire callback permission before RC payload/marker access, root proc before allocation, retain suspended parent activation roots, publish fresh parent view on callback exit; unknown writers, closure identity or nonlocal exit reject transfer

At a qualified safepoint spill live values, close ordinary root/payload writers and raw Scheme borrowers, pin frame/root locations; publish descriptor and NativeFrozen membership together; frozen locations permit collector writeback

One context, two abstract canonical root cells, two collection epochs, one nested callback and independent worker2; frame/denv root completeness and platform binding are premises; no real handler, stop or C weak-memory proof

22 conditional declarations: coverage composition, active/frozen duty Step/Trace conservation, relocation reload, reentry exclusion, activation and view lifetime; no induction over all QNT actions or C simulation
Active mutator ack becomes a frozen-root obligation in the same phase gate; collection includes every context generation exactly once; worker identity is independent of context or processor count

Release/acquire descriptor, scan completion and phase-gate publication must order root stores and reload; no racing plain C root loads or lock-free/liveness claim; generation wrap and aliases need platform refinement

Reentry request closes new round admission, honors already-enlisted pending/in-flight root scans, validates current epoch/roots/binding and grants active participation before reload; no second scan may race protected reload; metadata pins retire after use
Role-qualified worker owns writable canonical cells and relocation completion; moving roots updated in place or through proved writeback mapping; global collection/mutator barriers remain required
Real PSTATE, effective binding, VM and catcher restore are separately established on every admitted exit
Reserved scratch extent covers allocation, all exits and reload; nested saved writers cannot clobber it
Every live RC data slot belongs to the next scan census, including retained donors; splice and scan exclude concurrent mutation
Still preparation, foreign cleanup, native borrower drain and retained capacity charged exactly once before backing release
